Type of the console objects accepted by the logger.

## Signature

```typescript
export type LoggerConsole = Pick<Console, 'log' | 'error'>;
```

## Remarks

The logger uses only the `log()` function, for the standard output, and the `error()` function, for the standard error, so any object that has them can be used, not only a Node.js `Console`<!-- -->: a mock console, a custom object, or a minimal `{ log, error }` object.

The functions are called as methods of the object, so they may use `this`<!-- -->.
